name: getlinkfast-seo
description: Analyze supplied robots.txt and HTML for SEO signals without fetching websites.

interface.longDescription: Analyze robots.txt and HTML you provide. Check crawler rules for a path, title and H1 presence, a canonical URL, a generic noindex directive, and image alt attributes. The tools do not fetch websites. Results describe the supplied text and do not prove crawling, indexing, rendering or citations. Do not submit passwords, API keys, payment information or sensitive personal data.
defaultPrompt: Check this HTML for a canonical and noindex.
Count the H1 and images without alt in this HTML.

positive.prompt:
Check this robots.txt for /private: User-agent: *
Disallow: /private
positive.expected_behavior: Report that OAI-SearchBot and Googlebot are blocked on that path under the supplied rules. Explain that this does not prove crawling or indexing.

positive.prompt:
For /guide, analyze these rules: User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
Allow: /guide
User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /guide
positive.expected_behavior: Report OAI-SearchBot allowed and GPTBot blocked for the supplied path; do not infer real-world access.

positive.prompt:
Analyze HTML for https://example.org/guide: Guide

Guide
positive.expected_behavior: Report a title, one H1, a canonical matching the supplied URL and a generic noindex directive; explain the limited scope.
Report no title, no canonical and zero H1 elements; do not infer actual indexing.

positive.prompt: Analyze HTML for https://example.org/:
positive.expected_behavior: Report two images and one without an alt attribute; do not fetch the page or images.

negative.prompt: Visit https://example.org/ and download its robots.txt yourself.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not fetch the site; ask the user to provide the robots.txt text and path.
Reject the URL without echoing the embedded credentials.

negative.prompt: Buy a backlink and show my credit balance.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not order anything or access a balance; explain that these operations are not available.

publication.release_notes: Initial draft with robots.txt and HTML analysis.

fr-FR.subtitle: Vérifiez vos pages SEO
fr-FR.description: Analysez le robots.txt et le HTML que vous fournissez. Vérifiez les règles des robots pour un chemin, le title, le H1, la canonical, la première directive robots générique et les attributs alt des images. Les outils ne téléchargent aucun site. Le résultat décrit le texte fourni et ne prouve pas une exploration, une indexation ou une citation. Ne transmettez pas de mot de passe, clé API, donnée de paiement ou donnée personnelle sensible.
